items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: No, no, no, the one that they both worked with Cannonball, oh that was it, Cannonball.

ctx.x: No, no, no, the one that they both worked with Cannonball, oh that was it, Cannonball. Now they played a blues, and let me tell you, they were playing the real funk, stunk down, knock me down blues, you know. And that’s what you don’t hear too much. See so although they did play other things, they were able to play that because of the fact that they had this blues background. And that’s what’s very important. And when you don’t get a chance to experience playing the blues, you really just, you really don’t have…
And there seems to be a difference there, I’d like you to speak on this. The difference between execution and expression.
